--- sitemap: false layout: null --- {% raw %} LMs and Experts

How the LMs respond to users seeking personal advice, next to what the agent-experts say they should do

576 vignettes. Five LMs answered each one; five agent-experts, one per school of thought, said what the response should do. Every response was described on the same three response dimensions: what it leads with, its stance on the user's actions, and its stance on the user's framing. Orange is the LMs, blue the agent-experts.

Experts: Opus agent-experts with the current prompt. LMs: Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, Grok 4.7 and Gemini 4 Argon, each described by the same Gemini Flash judge. Situation dimensions are the values each vignette was generated from. Map: t-SNE on LM verdict and confidence, the user appraisals, the LM appraisals as LM minus user, and one-hot phase and goal (perplexity 30, seed 0); only neighborhoods are meaningful, not distances between clusters.
